title: Sequential OR tree correctness
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $A$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let $x$ assign a sign in $\\{ -1,1 \\}$ to each coordinate. The decision tree that queries the available coordinates in increasing order, returns $-1$ as soon as it finds a coordinate with value $-1$, and returns $1$ if all queried coordinates have value $1$ computes the function that is $1$ exactly when every coordinate in $A$ has value $1$, and is $-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\text{Fin }n$
